title: Continuation of protests against suspension of EU accession talks
location: Tbilisi, Zugdidi, Batumi, Kutaisi reported on 8 December; Rustaveli/New Year event mentioned in search-only liveblog for 31 December
notes: Social Justice Center says protests had continued continuously since 28 November and reports large-scale 8 December actions in four cities. Euronews 9 December request returned only a header, so its search snippet is not body evidence. Civil Georgia New Year liveblog is search-only and does not establish attendance or an end date. Do not create a new December event for this continuation.
open_questions: Were there qualifying gatherings on dates other than 8–9 December and 31 December?
What was the eventual end date of this protest campaign?
Was the New Year gathering a continuation with the same organization/demand or a distinct action?
